direct_owner_invariants: assignment_revision monotonic within job/partition scope; separate authority lease_epoch; incarnation is identity not authority.
Agent2 sole authority/fencing/epochs/supersession; Agent4 storage budgets/atomic publication; Agent5 placement/resource reservations.
Stale observations block new assignments; no-quorum blocks new quorum-dependent assignments/supersession.
Commit checks current assignment revision, lease epoch, fencing token and reservation.

requirement_provenance.correction: Agent5 authored F03/F04 exact t=100 rejection and half-open wall-clock-at-linearization semantics in a proposed INTEGRATION_PENDING spec. Those are not proof of a direct owner-approved physical serialization-time requirement. Earlier attribution of that stronger assumption as an established user mandate was too strong.
requirement_provenance.owner_instruction_violated_by_versioned_: None identified in the direct instructions available here, provided lease/reservation expiry is explicitly defined as committed authority invalidation in the NEW profile, civil deadlines remain separately enforced and no old contract is silently reinterpreted.

accepted_semantics: Single existing Consul/Raft authority; majority required; cached observations/heartbeats/local SQLite never grant rights.
Check exact current generation, leader session/index AND actual lease session binding/index plus assignment/grant/target registration and resource revisions in one transaction.
Committed lease or reservation invalidation/revocation before publication rejects every old effect even without a successor; publication first retains historical receipt/debit.
Renew/supersede/terminal transitions change the same checked grant/assignment records; old grant versions cannot publish after those transitions.
One bounded atomic closure/eligibility/coverage/allocation/debit/checkpoint/outbox/receipt boundary; no independent SQL commit or adoption/release bypass.
UNKNOWN original outcomes reconcile against original intent/receipt before new keys, capacity release or successor reuse.
Audit metadata names submission/observation truthfully and may be null under unqualified clocks; no fabricated exact commit timestamp.
explicit_profile_difference: A wall-clock display deadline may pass before Consul orders invalidation. In that interval a transaction with all current authority predicates may commit under v3. This does NOT pass the old strict wall-clock tests; old artifacts remain immutable. Fresh ROOT approval and explicit version/schema selection required.
remaining_implementation_decisions: Exact native lease-session acquisition/binding layout and lifecycle API must be specified and tested, not inferred from prose.

Renewal partial/UNKNOWN outcomes must reconcile actual session renewal and grant revision before reporting success or issuing any new fence; no local inferred extension. Scope of old-current grant during partial session renewal must be explicit in the final API.
Storage and compute reservation invalidation/version/accounting protocols must be exact, including unknown allocations remaining charged.
Civil-time policy (Europe/Berlin work windows, credentials/provider deadlines/confirmations) remains separate; displayed lease estimate cannot authorize new out-of-schedule work.
Paused external writer/sender containment or resource-side fencing remains mandatory before conflicting successor reuse.
checkpoint_compatibility: No implicit v1 committed_at_utc reinterpretation; A3/A4 exact new checkpoint/profile or explicit admitted semantic adapter required. Job resume/adoption references only committed verified checkpoint lineage.
required_v3_tests: lease invalidation first / no successor -> reject
reservation invalidation first -> reject even with valid lease
renewal and terminal CAS races -> stale grant rejects
pause before RPC with committed invalidation -> reject
display deadline elapsed without invalidation -> clearly v3-only permissible case, not strict-test PASS
restart/rejoin/generation preserve counters and receipt reconciliation
both renewal/session partial outcomes reconcile UNKNOWN
tests_executed_for_this_review: NONE; exact-byte semantic/requirements review only, not Consul/session/runtime acceptance.
source_and_schema_changes: NONE; all existing strict drafts/v1/P0 artifacts unchanged
